meta.description: Prepare cross-platform desktop packaging for PyQt with reproducible smoke verification. Use for shipping app binaries.

copy.tagline: 将 PyQt 应用打包为跨平台可执行文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把 PyQt 桌面应用分发给 Windows 和 Linux 用户
copy.tagline_en: Package PyQt apps into cross-platform executables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to distribute PyQt desktop apps to Windows and Linux users

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你把 PyQt 桌面应用打包成 Windows 和 Linux 的可执行文件，并自动进行冒烟测试验证打包是否成功。
howto.when: 当你需要将 PyQt 程序打包成跨平台可执行文件，或要求生成安装包时触发。

say.text: 帮我打包这个 PyQt 应用，生成 Windows 版 exe。
say.note: Claude 会读取代码并生成打包配置和可执行文件。

say.text: 为我的 PyQt 项目生成 Linux 版 AppImage。
验证刚才打包的 exe 能否正常运行。
say.note: Claude 会执行冒烟测试，检查核心功能是否正常。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you package PyQt desktop applications into executable files for Windows and Linux, and automatically perform smoke tests to verify the packaging.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to package a PyQt program into cross-platform executables or request an installer.

say_en.text: Package this PyQt app into a Windows exe.
say_en.note: Claude will read the code and generate packaging config and executable.

say_en.text: Generate a Linux AppImage for my PyQt project.
say_en.note: Claude will use PyInstaller or Briefcase for packaging.

say_en.text: Verify the exe we just built runs correctly.
say_en.note: Claude will run a smoke test to check core functionality.
